description: This file contains the Topic model class for the Opencart CMS module, implementing CRUD operations for topics, including managing descriptions, stores, layouts, SEO URLs, and cache invalidation.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Model class for managing topics in Opencart CMS, providing methods for CRUD operations, description management, store association, layouts, SEO URLs, and cache handling.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Creates a new topic record in the database with associated descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and layouts; returns the new topic ID.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Updates the specified topic record and its related descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and layouts in the database.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Deletes the specified topic and all related descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, and layouts from the database.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific topic, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of topics based on optional filters, supports sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTopics
methods.description: Returns the total count of topics matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description record for a specific topic in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in a specific language across all topics.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given topic, organized by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all topic descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a topic with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a given topic.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a topic with a layout for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a specific topic.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all topic layout associations for a given layout.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout IDs associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the number of topics associated with a specific layout ID.
